title: answer.cited, in the shared form of every support channel
description: B-207: the same answer as answer-cited.schema.json, sent once more on the server's events feed (/fabric/v1/events, list_agent_events) as a second answer.cited event whose data.schema is this one, in the form a chat support bot and the voice-of-customer board read: the channel as mail:<domain>:<local part>, one of 14 shared categories (an agent's category of the same name, else other), and a revision only in a data agent's <source>@<hex> form. Pick the form by data.schema. No sender, subject or text; question is the model's English restatement with personal data removed. workers/agents/learning-events.ts (sharedAnswerCitedEvent).

channel.description: mail:<domain>:<local part> of the Cloudflare address that sent the answer.

status.description: Fabric Inbox sends answered (it cited knowledge items) and general (it rested on the agent's own text); a rescue is support.diagnosed with rescued, and followup is not sent.

coverage.description: Each cited item's share of the question at the same index as cited; null when unknown.
